name: India
summary: India's best official test data are sandbox values: GSTINs listed for testing on NIC's e-invoice API developer portal, and test Aadhaar numbers that UIDAI publishes for its staging environment. The NIC portal could not be fetched directly, so the GSTINs were confirmed through search-engine extracts and a GSP's documentation. No authority reserves phone numbers, domains, PIN codes or company numbers for fiction, and no open API exists to check that a PAN or GSTIN is unused. India has no UBL: its e-invoice is a GSTN JSON schema, so only the identifiers carry over. Left out as unverified: the e-Way Bill sandbox GSTIN 05AAACG2140A1ZL (secondary sources only, PAN owner unknown), GSTINs derived from made-up PANs (no collision check possible), and the unregistered but unreserved domain example.in.

identifiers.name: GSTIN (GST identification number)
identifiers.format: 15 characters = 2-digit state code + PAN + entity number (1–9, A–Z) + Z + check character
identifiers.notes: Check character is Luhn mod-36 over the first 14 characters. GSTN has not published the algorithm; the rule used is python-stdnum's.

identifiers.name: PAN (Permanent Account Number)
identifiers.format: AAAAA9999A: 3 letters, holder-type letter (A B C F G H J L P T), initial of name, 4-digit serial, check letter
identifiers.notes: The check-letter algorithm is undocumented; validators check shape and holder type only. Since DGFT Trade Notice 09/2017 the importer-exporter code (IEC) equals the PAN.

identifiers.name: Aadhaar (UID)
identifiers.format: 12 digits, first digit not 0 or 1, Verhoeff check digit

identifiers.name: CIN (Corporate Identity Number)
identifiers.format: 21 characters: L/U + 5-digit NIC 2008 activity code + 2-letter state + 4-digit year + 3-letter class (PTC, PLC, OPC…) + 6-digit ROC number
identifiers.notes: No checksum. No MCA-published example was found.

identifiers.name: PIN code
identifiers.format: 6 digits; 1st digit = region (1–8 geographic, 9 Army Postal Service), first 3 = sorting district

identifiers.name: HSN code
identifiers.format: 4–8 digits based on the Harmonized System

entries.label: Tamil Nadu sandbox GSTIN on NIC's e-invoice API portal
entries.notes: Test GSTIN listed on the NIC e-invoice API sandbox page "Sync GSTIN Details from CP". The NIC site could not be fetched during research; the value was confirmed via search-engine extracts of the page and Masters India's API documentation. No live GST lookup was possible (captcha). Recommended: it also passes PAN shape and state-code checks.
